newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Island Dyeing conv notes issue approved.
newsitem.headline: Island Dyeing conv notes issue approved.

text.p: Island Dyeing and Printing Co Ltd said on Tuesday shareholders had approved its proposed issue of HK$100 million convertible notes in an extraordinary general meeting held on Monday.
The notes are expected to be issued on Janaury 30, it said in a statement.
In December, the company announced a plan to issue HK$100 million in convertible notes to repay a short-term bank loan, fund the demolition of a property and for working capital.

In the statement, Island Dyeing also said the government's Land Department had proposed a HK$805 million land premium for redeveloping a site in Kwai Chung in the New Territories into a commercial, office and apartment complex.
The property is the company's only major asset, it said.
"The board is considering the merits of proceeding with the land exchange relative to the amount of the premium assessed," the statement said.
